recognize_zh: HPLC 報告顯示 HbF 高達 95.0%、HbA0 僅 0.3%（幾乎沒有成人血紅素），HbA2 3.9%，沒有其他變異峰，這種「HbA 缺如、HbF 為主」的圖形符合 β0 型重度地中海貧血（未輸血狀態）。
features: HbF markedly elevated at 95.0% (retention time 1.20 min)
No abnormal variant peak; early peaks before 1 min represent minor/unknown fractions
describe_en: This is a cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography report rather than a morphologic image. The chromatogram is dominated by a HbF peak of 95.0%, with HbA0 virtually absent at 0.3% and HbA2 at 3.9%, and no abnormal variant hemoglobin peak. The near-complete absence of HbA with predominant HbF indicates absent beta-globin chain production, consistent with homozygous or compound heterozygous beta-zero thalassemia (beta-thalassemia major), provided the sample was obtained before transfusion. Molecular HBB analysis and parental studies are recommended to define the alleles.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin (homozygous deletional HPFH)
ddx.vs: Homozygous HPFH also has ~100% HbF but with normal-to-mild microcytosis, no significant anemia or hemolysis, and low or absent HbA2.
Newborns have predominant HbF but still show detectable HbA (typically 10-30%) and low HbA2.
Would show a large HbE fraction eluting in the A2 window (typically 40-60%), not an A2 of only 3.9%.
Recent transfusion introduces donor HbA and lowers the apparent HbF, so a pre-transfusion sample is required for interpretation.
